theater: 寧夏興慶府與河西走廊

battle.name: 蒙古與西夏戰爭
battle.theater: 寧夏興慶府與河西走廊
battle.brief: 一二〇五年冬，成吉思汗以西夏拒不出兵助金為由，率騎兵自河套南下，圍西夏都城中興府，數月不解；西夏遣使請和，蒙古退兵，一二〇七年與一二〇九年再攻，一二〇九年夏主受封，兩國以兄弟相稱。卡面希臘火與此役無涉，其噴火諸法只見於拜占庭海戰。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 一二〇五年開戰的兩方是蒙古部眾與西夏。蒙古方面，此時已完成對乃蠻、蔑兒乞與蒙古諸部的整合，一二〇六年春在斡難河源被推為大汗的成吉思汗是全軍最高統帥；編制仍沿草原舊俗，萬戶、百戶、千戶十進制分轄各部，怯薛宿衞近衞大汗，左右膀手與探馬散騎分掌警衞與偵察，十戶長以上各有怯薛隨行。行軍不靠攻城器械而靠馬匹：帳氈、木車、皮囊裝的乳酪與風乾肉隨隊轉移，牲畜群即軍糧。蒙古本部兵之外，先後歸附的畏兀兒、札剌亦、乃蠻與漢地降軍亦被編入，分別承擔攻堅與守附。西夏方面，首都興慶府（亦稱中興府，今寧夏銀川）所在的河套西岸是其根基，漢式官署中書省與樞密院分掌政務與軍令，党項部眾按戶出丁，兵種以披鐵甲的精騎（宋人舊稱鐵鷂子）與步兵為主，攻城守城倚重漢地匠人造的撞車、雲梯與弓弩，西北面則以黑水、瓜州的邊寨與烽堠構成外圍屏障。整體格局是金、宋、西夏、蒙古四方互相羈制：宋與西夏和好、歲幣往來，金在蒙古壓力下向西夏求援，西夏正想兩面周旋，卻正因此被蒙古看穿。
countriesEn: The two parties that went to war in 1205 were the Mongols and Western Xia. On the Mongol side the union of the Naiman, the Merkit and the other Mongol tribes was by then complete, and Genghis Khan, who was proclaimed great khan on the Onon river in the spring of 1206, was the supreme commander of the whole army. The organisation still followed the old steppe custom, the decimal units of ten thousand, one hundred and one thousand men each commanding a division, the keshig as the household guard about the khan's person, and the left and right wings with their outriders in charge of reconnaissance, ten-man leaders and upwards each with a keshig man of their own. Marching depended on horses rather than on siege trains: tents, wooden carts, leather bags of dried milk and wind-dried meat moved with the column, and the herds were the army's rations. Beyond the Mongol core, men drawn from the peoples who had submitted in turn — Uighurs, Jadarid, Naiman and Chinese troops from the conquered country — were allotted the assault and the holding of dependent towns. On the Xia side the basis of the state was the river land west of the great bend, where the capital Xingqing, also called Zhongxing, stood (modern Yinchuan in Ningxia). Chinese-style offices, a Secretariat and a Board of War, divided state business from military command; the Tangut households each furnished a man, and the army consisted chiefly of armoured picked horse — called the iron vulture by the Song writers — and of foot. Siege and wall defence relied on the ram, the scaling ladder and the bows and crossbows built by craftsmen from the Chinese lands, while on the north-west the border forts and beacon towers of Heishui and Guazhou formed the outer screen. The wider setting was a four-way balance of Jin, Song, Xia and Mongol: the Song and Xia lived in amity and exchanged the yearly payments, the Jin begged Xia for help under Mongol pressure, and Xia meant to play both sides — and that was precisely what the Mongols read.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的自然是成吉思汗。他本人在一〇二〇年代之後由一個部落的酋長成為草原共主，一二〇四年滅乃蠻、一二〇五年掃平金朝北部之後，蒙古已無內部牽制；正是在這個當口，他向西夏提出出兵助金的要求，遭拒後親率大軍南下，把第一次大規模的攻城作戰放在西夏都城之下。圍城數月不下，他沒有硬攻到底，而是接受西夏的請和條件，把攻城換成外交的收益，這一取捨在往後二十年的西夏問題上一再重演。木華黎是蒙古在漠南河套與河西一線的經營者，後來統軍西征，一二二七年攻西夏時病歿軍中，卒年有作一二二八年者。西夏主襄宗李安全在拒絕助金之際，大概以為可以兩面討好；嗣位的神宗李遵顼（項元昊）則目睹蒙古三次來攻，在一二〇九年前後接受蒙古的封號，以稱臣與助軍換取國祚延續。漢人臣僚在西夏朝廷中掌文書、度支與對宋往來，使者往來於興慶、汴京與中都之間，是西夏外交真正的執行層。
peopleEn: What decided the course of this war was Genghis Khan himself. By the 1020s he had gone from the chief of a single tribe to the common lord of the steppe; after destroying the Naiman in 1204 and sweeping the north of the Jin in 1205, the Mongols had no internal distraction left, and it was precisely at that moment that he demanded troops from Western Xia to assist the war against the Jin, and, being refused, marched south with the main army and put his first large assault against a walled capital. When the siege dragged on for months without success he did not force the issue but took the terms of peace Xia offered, exchanging an assault for a diplomatic gain — a choice he repeated again and again in the Xia question over the following twenty years. Muqali was the man who held the line of the Hetao and of the Hexi corridor for the Mongols and who later led the expedition to the west; he died of illness in the field during the campaign against Xia in 1227, though the year of his death is given variously as 1228. The Xia ruler Xiangzong, Li Anquan, may have believed when he refused to send troops against the Jin that he could please both sides; his successor, the Divine Ruler Li Zunxu, known as Xiang Yuanhao, watched the Mongols come three times and, around 1209, accepted a title from them, trading submission and military service for the survival of the dynasty. Chinese officials in the Xia court handled the written business, the accounts and the intercourse with the Song, and envoys passed between Xingqing, Bianjing and the Jin capital of Zhongdu; they were the working layer of Xia's diplomacy.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火是七世紀拜占庭帝國的秘密兵器：稠厚難熄的燃燒劑灌在銅管與虹吸管中，靠人力泵推送，噴向水面或船舷，用來封住正在靠岸的敵船；帝國把配方列為最高機密，傳說配方隨一艘沉船一同失落，此後再沒有第二套辦法。一二〇四年第四次十字軍攻陷君士坦丁堡時，拜占庭人仍以它對付維內托人的艦隊，然而拉丁帝國建立之後，這條配方線就在西方中斷，再沒有恢復。蒙古與拜占庭之間從無往來，西夏也不是拜占庭的盟友，因此一二〇年代黃河兩岸沒有任何一件拜占庭火器出現，這一點可以說是確定的；希臘火在這張卡上是一條斷線上的標本，它的技術譜系在十三世紀初止於拉丁征服，而同一時期真正延續下來的是火藥路線。可以對照的，是同一戰區確實存在的噴射燃燒器械：宋人《武經總要》一〇四四年收錄的猛火油柜，以唧筒盛油壓出，用於守城與攻樓；另有宋人記載西夏備有「佛箱」一類以壓力噴射燃燒物料的器械，後世研究者常拿它與希臘火並列，但形制與源流都無從考證。蒙古軍本身的裝備以冷兵器為主：短刀、長矛、蒙古弓、少量鐵甲與皮甲，攻城靠雲梯、撞車、穴地與木製拋石，輔以火矢與火炬照明，真正的火藥武器要到一二二七年攻滅西夏才見於記錄。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card is the secret weapon of the seventh-century Byzantine Empire: a burning fluid, thick and hard to extinguish, poured into bronze tubes and siphons, pushed out by hand pumps and sprayed at the waterline or at the flank of a ship, its task to seal a vessel that was trying to come alongside. The empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and the story runs that it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of making it was ever found. When the Fourth Crusade took Constantinople in 1204 the Byzantines still used it against the Venetian fleet; but once the Latin Empire was established, this line of formula was broken in the West and never recovered. There was never any contact between the Mongols and the Byzantines, and Xia was no ally of Byzantium either, so in the 1200s no Byzantine fire weapon appeared on either bank of the Yellow River; that much can be said with certainty. Greek fire on this card is the specimen of a broken line: its technical pedigree ended with the Latin conquest in the early thirteenth century, while the line that did carry on was the gunpowder one. What can genuinely be set beside it are the projecting burning instruments that did exist in the same theatre: the fierce-fire oil chest entered in the Song Wujing Zongyao of 1044, in which oil paste was pressed out of a cylinder and used to hold a wall or set a tower alight; and, in Song accounts, Western Xia is credited with an instrument called the fo box, a pressure device for throwing burning material, which later scholars often place alongside Greek fire, though neither its shape nor its origin can be established. The Mongol army's own equipment was cold weapons above all: short sabres, long spears, the Mongol bow, a little iron and leather armour, with scaling ladders, rams, mine digging and wooden counterweight trebuchets for the assault, and fire arrows and torches for light. Real gunpowder weapons do not appear in the records until the destruction of Xia in 1227.
tactics: 蒙古的戰術是草原式的機動加心戰。一二〇五年冬，大軍自河套與黑水一線南下，趁黃河結冰渡河，直抵興慶城下；圍城之後不急著強攻，而是以散騎游弋掠奪城郊牲畜與草料，切斷城內的柴炭與糧食來源，迫近外郭村落，逼守軍收縮，同時派使議和。西夏應對以城防為主：興慶府有堅固城垣與黃河天塹，城周灌溉渠密佈，可供遠射與反擊；守軍以神臂弓、火箭覆蓋城下通道，出城輕騎襲擾蒙古營地、分割其遊牧隊伍奪取水草，把對方的騎射優勢在近身戰中抵消；談判則是另一支手段，西夏寧可讓步也不願城破，屢次遣使輸馬求和。一二〇七年再攻與一二〇九年第三次圍城，重複的是同一套節奏：蒙古遊騎掠地、封鎖通道、拖到對方缺糧，再以和議收兵。蒙古之所以能三次逼近而不用攻城器械硬攻，是因為蒙古本部沒有成熟的攻城技術，遠征補給全靠牲畜與就牧，冬天草枯馬瘦，久圍不起；西夏之能守，是因為城堅、渠深、糧秣可以從灌渠農業中來。雙方的勝負手其實在馬匹與草料，不在牆下的任何一件火器。
tacticsEn: The Mongol tactic was steppe mobility combined with psychological pressure. In the winter of 1205 the main army came down from the Hetao and the Heishui line, crossed the Yellow River while it was frozen, and came up against the walls of Xingqing; once there it did not hurry to force the gates but sent out light horse to carry off the livestock and fodder of the suburbs, cutting the firewood and food of the city, pressing in on the outer villages and forcing the defenders to draw in, while envoys went in and out to talk terms. Xia answered by making the city the main line of defence: Xingqing had strong walls and the Yellow River as a moat, and the irrigation channels that ran round it gave the defenders the means to shoot and to strike; the garrison covered the ground below the walls with heavy crossbows and fire arrows, and light horse went out of the gate to harry the Mongol camp and cut up the herds, taking the enemy's advantage in mounted archery out of the fight at close quarters. Negotiation was the other instrument: Xia would rather give ground than see the city taken, and sent envoys with horses to ask for peace again and again. The attack of 1207 and the third siege of 1209 repeated the same rhythm — the Mongol light horse swept the country, sealed the roads, waited for the enemy to run short of food, and then ended the business with a settlement. The Mongols could press in three times without using their siege engines because they had no developed siegecraft, and their supplies on campaign depended entirely on animals and grazing; in winter the grass failed and the horses went thin, so a long siege was impossible. Xia could hold out because the walls were strong, the channels deep, and its grain came from irrigated farming. The decisive factor on both sides was therefore horses and fodder, not any weapon of fire beneath the walls.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：蒙古於一二〇五年冬出兵，圍興慶府數月，至一二〇六年春罷兵；一二〇七年再攻；一二〇九年第三次圍城，西夏遣使請和，蒙古承認其王號，此後西夏依約以軍馬與物資助蒙古攻金。兵力：元代史籍對蒙古大軍多用概數，如「大軍十萬」之類，實際列陣人數無法核實；西夏則是可與宋對抗的西北強國，總人口常被估為二百餘萬，能徵之兵以數萬計，一座興慶府的守軍亦在數千上下，但精騎與重裝馬隊的數量遠少於蒙古。距離：河西走廊自瓜州至涼州約一千數百里，蒙古根據地與興慶之間的距離在數百里上下，騎兵來回一趟多則數十日。損耗：蒙古三次遠征的真正損失不在陣亡而在牲畜與草料，冬季牧場枯萎是迫使蒙古退兵的主因；西夏屢次輸馬助金與歲賜往來的數目，文獻只留概數。貢馬與封號的細節，各家史籍互有出入。凡確切死傷、兵員點驗、各次圍城的確切起訖月份，記錄都不可靠，此處只採可以互相印證的量級說法，不作精確斷言。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. Timing: the Mongols took the field in the winter of 1205, held Xingqing for several months and stood down in the spring of 1206; they came again in 1207; and in 1209 they besieged the city a third time, Xia sent envoys to ask for peace, the Mongols acknowledged its royal title, and from then on Xia supplied horses and materiel to help the Mongols against the Jin. Strength: Yuan-period historians use round numbers for the Mongol host, such as an army of one hundred thousand; the number actually in the line cannot be verified. Xia was a north-western power able to stand against the Song, its total population is commonly estimated at something over two million, the men it could muster numbered in the tens of thousands, the garrison of a city such as Xingqing ran to several thousand, and the number of armoured picked horse was far smaller than the Mongol. Distances: the Hexi corridor runs some thousand-odd li from Guazhou to Liangzhou, and the distance from the Mongol base to Xingqing was in the several hundreds of li, a ride of tens of days each way. Losses: the real cost of the three expeditions fell not on the battlefields but on animals and fodder, and the withering of the winter pasture was the main reason the Mongols withdrew; the numbers of horses given up by Xia and of the yearly payments are recorded only in round figures. The details of the tribute horses and of the titles differ from house to house among the histories. For exact casualties, verified strengths and the precise opening and closing months of each siege the record is not reliable, and only the order of magnitude that can be cross-checked is given here.
cause: 打起上來的直接因由是蒙古向西夏索兵。一二〇五年蒙古正在金朝北部作戰，金朝失去屏障之後向西夏求援，成吉思汗也要西夏出兵一萬助金攻勢，這在草原外交中既是徵召也是試探：出一萬兵，是承認蒙古的宗主地位；拒不出兵，等於宣告西夏要自己站一邊。西夏拒絕，理由並不難懂。其一，西夏多年與宋和好、每歲受賜，表面臣屬而實則自主，絕不肯為金人出力而失去宋朝這條線；其二，西夏看得見蒙古的騎兵在乃蠻與金地是如何移動的，知道西面是當時唯一的新強，不願在沒有把握的時候與之結死怨；其三，蒙古提出的出兵數目與西夏的國力不相稱，党項部眾按戶出丁，壯丁有限，馬匹與牧場才是立國之本，一次抽調一萬騎對西夏本身就是重傷。但西夏也誤判了形勢：它以為蒙古遠在漠北、與金人隔著大片草地，攻到西夏要走很遠的補給線，因此不急於備戰；它沒有估到蒙古先滅乃蠻再掃金北，戰力已經整合，隨時可以沿既有的牧道直下河套。河西走廊本身也是深層原因：那是西夏的立國通道，也是蒙古通往西域的必經之路，蒙古在漠北已強，河西就不能容許一個不聽話的政權橫在前面。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for the fighting was the Mongol demand for troops. In 1205 the Mongols were campaigning in the north of the Jin; the Jin, having lost its screen, begged Xia for help, and Genghis Khan also demanded that Xia send ten thousand men to help the attack. In steppe diplomacy such a demand was both a levy and a test: to send ten thousand men was to acknowledge the overlordship of the Mongols, and to refuse was to declare that Xia meant to stand on its own. Xia refused, and the reason is not hard to see. First, Xia had long lived in amity with the Song and received its yearly payments, was a subject in name but autonomous in fact, and would not spend its strength for the Jin at the cost of that line to the Song. Second, Xia could see how Mongol horsemen moved against the Naiman and in Jin territory, and understood that the west was the one new and rising power; it had no wish to make a mortal enemy of that power without assurance. Third, the number demanded bore no relation to Xia's means: the Tangut households furnished a man each, the able-bodied were few, horses and pastures were the foundation of the state, and the levy of ten thousand riders would itself have been a wound. But Xia misread the situation. It assumed that the Mongols were far away in the steppe, separated from the Jin by wide grazing country, and that an army attacking Xia would have a very long supply line to keep; it did not allow for the fact that the Mongols had first destroyed the Naiman and then swept the north of the Jin, that their strength was already consolidated, and that they could come down the existing grazing roads to the Hetao at once. The Hexi corridor lay deeper still: it was the artery of Xia's own state and at the same time the necessary road for the Mongols to the western regions, and a power already strong in the steppe could not afford to leave a disobedient state across its path.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了西夏的命運，也改變了蒙古的戰略。一二〇九年之後，西夏從兩個強權之間的獨立玩家，變成蒙古名下的附庸：它要稱臣、要輸馬、要在蒙古攻金時出兵配合；二十年後一二二六年成吉思汗再舉大軍、西夏末主出降，一二二七年西夏亡國，河西走廊與河套的通道全部打開，一二一九年西征的後路從此再沒有西夏這個障礙。蒙古在這幾年裡學會了第一件重要的事：對付有城有渠的農業政權，攻城遠不如逼和划算；這個判斷在二十年後被推翻，攻金與西征消耗了蒙古的元氣，最後一次的西夏戰役蒙古再不肯停在外交屈服上，而是用火器破城，這條火藥線上的記載，被不少學者視為火藥武器用於西方戰場的早期證據之一。對宋的方面，蒙古在西夏得手之後轉向南方，一二一一年遣使與宋議和攻金，宋廷拒絕，同時在洮、熙、岷一線增築堡寨、積儲糧草，把西北防務從對夏改成對蒙，二十年後才被迫改弦。技術層面，西夏與蒙古都在這一時期加快冶鐵與火器的吸收，宋人記載中「佛箱」一類噴射燃燒器械的說法，正可以放在這條線上看；與此同時，拜占庭那邊，希臘火在拉丁人攻陷君士坦丁堡之後中斷，配方未再恢復，十三世紀初的技術地圖上，一條線斷在歐洲，一條線伸向蒙古騎兵。
impactEn: This war changed the fate of Xia and the thinking of the Mongols. After 1209, Xia changed from an independent player between two great powers into a vassal of the Mongols: it had to bow, to give horses, to send troops when the Mongols campaigned against the Jin. Twenty years later, in 1226, Genghis Khan raised a great army once more, the last Xia ruler surrendered, and in 1227 the state of Xia was destroyed; the corridor of the Hexi and the road of the Hetao were thrown open, and from then on the rear of the campaign of 1219 was no longer blocked by Xia. The Mongols learned one important lesson in these years: against an agricultural state with walls and canals, diplomacy was far cheaper than a siege. That judgement was overturned twenty years later — the wars against the Jin and in the west had drained the Mongols, and in the last campaign against Xia they no longer stopped at a diplomatic submission but broke the city with gunpowder weapons; the records of that line are treated by many scholars as among the earliest evidence of gunpowder weapons in warfare in the West. On the Song side, having got the better of Xia, the Mongols turned south: in 1211 they sent an envoy to propose joint action against the Jin, the Song court refused, and at the same time built more forts and stored grain along the Tao, Xi and Min lines, changing the north-west defence from one directed at Xia into one directed at the Mongols — a change the Song was forced to reverse twenty years later. On the technical side, both Xia and the Mongols hastened the absorption of metallurgy and fire weapons in this period, and the Song accounts of a device like the fo box are best read on that line; meanwhile, in Byzantium, the Greek fire was broken by the Latin conquest after the fall of Constantinople and its formula was never recovered, so that on the technological map of the early thirteenth century one line was cut in Europe and another stretched towards the Mongol horseman.
result: 結果是蒙古以外交取勝、以攻城收手。一二〇五年冬的第一次圍城，蒙古沒有攻下興慶府：城池堅固、灌渠縱橫、守軍的遠射與火器齊備，蒙古自己的攻城技術與遠程補給都不到位，久圍無益，雙方在冬去春來之間議和罷兵。一二〇七年再攻，仍不能破；一二〇九年第三次圍城，西夏主遣使乞和，接受蒙古的封號並許諾助軍攻金，蒙古遂解圍而去，轉而把西夏納入對金作戰的體系。換句話說，一二〇五年開局的那場戰爭並沒有真正的攻城勝利，它結束在西夏稱臣、輸馬、供兵的安排上，而這份安排在二十二年後被蒙古單方面撕毀。對卡面這件兵器可以確定的只有一句：希臘火與蒙古和西夏的戰爭毫無關係，它的配方在十三世紀初隨拉丁征服的斷裂而永久失傳，從未出現在黃河兩岸的戰場上；這一役真正起作用的是馬蹄、弓弦、草料與黃河的冰期，而火的另一條線則從拜占庭的銅管裡斷掉，一路繞到蒙古人手中，最後才在一二一九年之後的西征與西夏的最後一役裡重新出現。
resultEn: The result was a diplomatic victory for the Mongols and a withdrawal from the walls. The first siege of the winter of 1205 did not take Xingqing: the walls were strong, the irrigation channels ran through the city, the garrison had both long-range weapons and fire, the Mongols had neither the siegecraft nor the lines of supply for a long operation, and it was useless to stay through the winter into the spring. In the spring of 1206 the two sides made terms and stood down. The attack of 1207 failed to take the city as well; in 1209 the third siege ended when the Xia ruler sent envoys to ask for peace, accepted a title from the Mongols and undertook to send troops against the Jin, and the Mongols lifted the blockade and turned instead to using Xia in their war with the Jin. In other words, the war begun in 1205 ended in no real assault victory: it ended in an arrangement by which Xia bowed, gave horses and supplied men, and that arrangement was torn up by the Mongols twenty-two years later in a single stroke. Of the weapon on this card only one thing can be said with certainty: Greek fire had nothing to do with the war between the Mongols and Western Xia; its formula was permanently lost when the Latin conquest broke the line in the early thirteenth century, and it never appeared on any battlefield along the Yellow River. What really decided this campaign was the horseshoe, the bowstring, the fodder and the freezing of the river; and the other line of fire, cut off at the bronze tube in Byzantium, ran round to the hands of the Mongols and only reappeared in the western expedition after 1219 and in the last campaign against Xia.
